KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE: Will improve the appearance of your Raider Den.
KeysToEntries.ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE_A: Upgrade your stash to gain stash space, allowing you to collect and store more items. This may also improve the appearance your Raider Den.

ID_RAIDERDEN_BUTTON_APPEARANCE.Note: Name of button in the Raider Den where the player can change their appearance

ID_RAIDERDEN_BUTTON_APPEARANCE_ALT2.Note: Name of button in the Raider Den where the player can change their appearance, alternative

ID_RAIDERDEN_BUTTON_APPEARANCE_ALT3.Note: Button to open the screen where you customize your raider

ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE.Note: Message on the stash expansion modal to clarify that your raider den will visually update when you stash upgrade

ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE_A.Note: Message on the stash expansion modal to tell you that your raider den will update. Though it doesn't update every level, thus "may"
